ERW Pipe Manufacturer, Stockist & Exporter in India – Exotic Metals 
 LLP
Introduction: Precision Welding for Industrial 
 Reliability
At 
Exotic Metals LLP,
 our 
ERW Pipes
 (Electric Resistance Welded) represent a pinnacle of 
 modern manufacturing efficiency. Produced from high-quality steel coils, these pipes 
 are formed by cold-rolling the strip into a cylindrical shape and then welding the 
 longitudinal seam using high-frequency electric current. Unlike traditional welding 
 methods that require filler metal, ERW pipes utilize the heat generated by the 
 resistance of the metal itself to create a fusion bond that is as strong as the 
 parent material. 
As a leading manufacturer and exporter in India, Exotic 
 Metals LLP ensures that every ERW pipe undergoes rigorous heat treatment of the weld 
 seam—a process known as "seam annealing"—to eliminate any potential hardness 
 gradients. This results in a pipe with a homogenous grain structure that is highly 
 resistant to internal pressure and mechanical stress. Our ERW pipes are the 
 preferred choice for high-volume applications in water transport, oil and gas line 
 pipe, structural scaffolding, and the automotive sector.

Primary Types of ERW Pipes
Exotic Metals LLP offers a specialized range of ERW pipes tailored to specific pressure 
 ratings and environmental conditions:
Water and Gas Line Pipes
These are standard-duty pipes used for the conveyance of 
 non-critical fluids. Available in "Light," "Medium," and "Heavy" 
 classes, they are often galvanized to prevent rust in plumbing 
 and irrigation systems.
API 5L Line Pipes for Oil & 
 Gas
Our high-performance ERW pipes for the energy sector are 
 manufactured under the API 5L specification. These pipes are 
 designed to handle the transportation of petroleum, natural gas, 
 and water under high pressure, available in grades ranging from 
 B up to X80. 
Structural ERW Pipes
Specifically engineered for load-bearing applications, these 
 pipes are used in the construction of bridges, stadium roofs, 
 and industrial sheds. They offer an excellent strength-to-weight 
 ratio and are easily welded into complex frameworks.
Precision ERW Tubes
Processed with tighter dimensional tolerances and a superior 
 surface finish, these tubes are intended for the automotive and 
 furniture industries. They are frequently used for shock 
 absorbers, steering columns, and high-end furniture frames.
Boiler and Heat Exchanger ERW 
 Tubes
Designed for high-temperature service, these pipes undergo 
 specialized eddy current testing to ensure the absolute 
 integrity of the weld seam, preventing leaks in critical heat 
 transfer equipment.

 standard and corrosive environments:

 X80. 
Stainless Steel:
 304, 304L, 316, 316L, 321 (For specialized exhaust and 
 chemical lines). 
Alloy Steel:
 P11, P22, P5, P9 (For high-temperature structural use). 
Galvanized Steel:
 Hot-dip galvanized for superior atmospheric corrosion 
 resistance.

Delivery & Packaging Information
At Exotic Metals LLP, we utilize high-standard logistics to protect the integrity of the weld and the pipe ends:
End Protection:
 All pipes are fitted with plastic or metal end protectors to prevent damage to the beveled ends or threads during handling.
Surface Coating:
 To prevent transit rust, pipes are coated with black varnish, anti-rust oil, or are hot-dip galvanized according to client preference.
Secure Bundling:
 Small diameter pipes are bundled in hexagonal shapes with steel strapping. Large diameter pipes are delivered in loose condition with protective slings.
Export Packing:
 For international maritime shipping, bundles are wrapped in moisture-proof HDPE fabric and placed in reinforced steel-framed crates if required.
Traceability:
 Every pipe is marked with its Heat Number, Specification, Grade.
Quality Assurance:
 We supply Mill Test Certificates (MTC) as per EN 10204 3.1, along with Hydro-test, Eddy Current, and Ultrasonic test reports.
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
Is ERW pipe as strong as Seamless pipe?
Modern ERW pipes, especially those manufactured by Exotic Metals LLP, utilize high-frequency welding and online seam annealing. This makes the weld seam virtually indistinguishable from the parent metal in terms of strength. For most medium-pressure and structural applications, ERW is an excellent and cost-effective alternative to seamless.
What is the difference between ERW and HFI pipes?
HFI (High Frequency Induction) is a type of ERW welding that uses induction coils to heat the edges. It is a more advanced version of ERW that provides a very clean, high-quality weld, typically used for API 5L line pipes.
Can ERW pipes be used for underground oil pipelines?
Yes, when manufactured to API 5L standards and properly coated (such as 3LPE coating), ERW pipes are widely used for cross-country oil and gas transportation.
Does Exotic Metals LLP offer Galvanized ERW pipes?
Yes, we provide hot-dip galvanizing for ERW pipes, which involves submerging the pipe in molten zinc to create a thick, corrosion-resistant layer, extending the pipe's life in outdoor or underground use.
